scope: Independently normalize and discretize the physical first-order GE05 per-node bath Euler residual E_q10 on a frozen common ln(a) grid and bind its signed +4 E_q10 q10,x eta-regularized mixed H4 Ward parent factor. The local physical residual is report-only until a separately preregistered full all-sector FD4/FD8 error budget and exact H4F3b/Z11 parents are accessible. Manufactured polynomial kinematics/FD4 tests may run on Actions but must not be called physical Noether PASS.

action_normalization.mode_pair_analytic_only: -2*w/omega^2*R_z10*ik*z; this is a per-node mode-coefficient product, not the Fourier coefficient of the physical product until real-space convolution is performed
action_normalization.first_order_kinematics: v=tau*H*D_ln(a) z; check analytically for manufactured fixture

manufactured_cases.fixture: z=e^{-3x}P4(x) times fixed nonzero complex node/mode amplitudes; v=tau*H*z_x; J=a^3*v/tau is degree <=4 polynomial
manufactured_cases.X10: z+H*J_x/(a^3*omega^2) so the exact analytic Euler residual is zero

outcomes.COMPILER_PASS: Frozen action/sign/normalization and manufactured FD4/kinematics gates pass. Freeze restricted compiler only; actual q10 parent arrays, all-sector Euler and physical Ward remain open.
outcomes.COMPILER_FAIL: Freeze exact failed symbolic/manufactured/input gate without relabeling physical H4.
